findings.evidence: collect_process_metrics publishes "tool_latency_window_s": 300.0 as a hardcoded literal while the actual window is TOOL_LATENCY_WINDOW_SECONDS = 300.0 in metrics/collector.py; if that constant is ever changed, the published metadata silently disagrees with the real window and consumers computing rat
findings.title: Published window duplicates the collector constant as a literal

findings.evidence: The samples count sums ts >= cutoff over deque(maxlen=2000), so a tool with more than 2000 calls inside the 300 s window reports samples=2000 and the percentiles cover only the newest 2000 samples; docs say 'samples sums window samples', which understates high-volume tools (pinned as intended behavi
findings.title: samples is clamped at the 2000-sample deque bound
